attention4.ptxt: If TCM learning value clearance is not performed after one of the following operations has been performed, there is a possibility that the vehicle will not be able to move.
Perform TCM learning value clearance whenever one of the following operations has been performed:

item.ptxt: Valve body assembly is removed or replaced.
A/T assembly is disassembled or replaced.

s1.ptxt: With ignition “OFF”, connect SUZUKI scan tool to DLC.
Select “A/T Learned Initialize” in “Active test” menu, and follow instructions displayed on SUZUKI scan tool.
